notes.title: Bugfixes!
notes.notes:
Tonight's update fixes two issues:
1. The music room track list once again scrolls with the cursor.
2. I'm quite sure that I finally pinned down and fixed the softlock issue that has been plaguing the game since release.

As always, please report any issues you encounter, new or old, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Version 1.2 Released - Introducing Rumia Mode!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, version 1.2 is available!

This version brings the standard issue update to the latest version of the Unity Engine, as well as a new music track: [i]Voile, the Magic Library[/i] from Embodiment of Scarlet Devil.

The biggest addition, however, is the new Rumia mode! It's an expert mode in which block faces are blacked out, you get no block previews, and you start with rows of blocks already on the board. There's also a cool new bomb. Enjoy!

There's another music track I'll probably add in due time but for now, give Rumia mode a try and let me know what you think!

notes.title: New Game Reveal - Tea Time
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39043657/729d895ba5ba2a62c0966fbfd98a58147df8e6b2.png[/img]

Hey everybody, I'm announcing my next game, Tea Time! It's a high-score focused game where you try to catch as many falling objects as possible through five stages, while obstacles get in your way to prevent collection. You'll be able to select from multiple characters, each with two powers to select from.

Testing and QC is almost done, and then work on Steam integration will begin. My goal is to get it out by the end of the year, so keep an eye out for it!

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes: I pushed out a minor update today, to hopefully resolve a black screen issue when resizing the game window. A recent Unity release fixed a bug that sounds related to the report I received and though I couldn't reproduce it, there's no harm in updating the Unity player anyway. Please let me know if the black screen issue continues to be a problem for any of you.

notes.title: Yukari Version 1.1 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, version 1.1 is out! Here's the changes:
1. Fix to a small graphical glitch in relation to tall gaps
2. Two more music tracks to choose from (each with two versions)
3. You can now change your music during the game from the pause screen, switching to another one of your three presets.
